lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਥਾਪੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਧਰਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh thaape chaare jug too karataa sagal dharan ||
lines.translation: You established the four ages; You are the Creator of all worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aavan jaanaa keeaa tudh lep na lagai trin ||
lines.translation: You created the comings and goings of reincarnation; not even a particle of filth sticks to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis hovahi aap daiaal tis laavahi satigur charan ||
lines.translation: As you are merciful, You attach us to the Feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਲਭਹੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਣ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too horat upaai na labhahee abinaasee srisat karan ||2||
lines.translation: You cannot be found by any other efforts; You are the eternal, imperishable Creator of the Universe. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਵਤਹਿ ਅੰਙਣੇ ਹਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je too vatahi a(n)ngane habh dharat suhaavee hoi ||
lines.translation: If You come into my courtyard, all the earth becomes beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਸੁ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਮੈਡੀ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hikas ka(n)tai baaharee maidee vaat na puchhai koi ||1||
lines.translation: Other than the One Lord, my Husband, no one else cares for me. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਸਹੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਅੰਙਣੁ ਮਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: habhe tol suhaavane sahu baithaa a(n)ngan mal ||
lines.translation: All my adornments become beautiful, when You, O Lord, sit in my courtyard and make it Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹੀ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਬਿਰਥੜਾ ਜੋ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pahee na va(n)njai birathaRaa jo ghar aavai chal ||2||
lines.translation: Then no traveller who comes to my home shall leave empty-handed. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਕੰਤ ਕੂ ਕੀਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej vichhaaee ka(n)t koo keeaa habh seegaar ||
lines.translation: I have spread out my bed for You, O my Husband Lord, and applied all my decorations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ਜੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: itee ma(n)jh na samaavaee je gal pahiraa haar ||3||
lines.translation: But even this is not pleasing to me, to wear a garland around my neck. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too paarabraham paramesar jon na aavahee ||
lines.translation: O Supreme Lord God, O Transcendent Lord, You do not take birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too hukamee saajahi srisat saaj samaavahee ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of Your Command, You formed the Universe; forming it, You merge into it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa roop na jaaee lakhiaa kiu tujhahi dhiaavahee ||
lines.translation: Your Form cannot be known; how can one meditate on You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sabh mahi varatahi aap kudarat dekhaavahee ||
lines.translation: You are pervading and permeating all; You Yourself reveal Your creative potency.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daar tot na aavahee ||
lines.translation: Your treasures of devotional worship are overflowing; they never decrease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehi ratan javehar laal keem na paavahee ||
lines.translation: These gems, jewels and diamonds - their value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis hovahi aap daiaal tis satigur sevaa laavahee ||
lines.translation: As You Yourself become merciful, Lord, You link us to the service of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis kade na aavai tot jo har gun gaavahee ||3||
lines.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, never suffers any deficiency. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੂ ਪਸੀ ਹਠ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿਜੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa moo pasee hath mai piree mahijai naal ||
lines.translation: When I look within my being, I find that my Beloved is with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖ ਉਲਾਹਿਅਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: habhe dukh ulaahiam naanak nadar nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: All pains are relieved, O Nanak, when He bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੈਠਾ ਭਖੇ ਵਾਉ ਲੰਮੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak baithaa bhakhe vaau la(n)me sevahi dar khaRaa ||
lines.translation: Nanak sits, waiting for news of the Lord, and stands at the Lord's Door; serving Him for so long.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀਏ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਸਾਉ ਜੋਈ ਸਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਖੜਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pireee too jaan mahijaa saau joee saaee muhu khaRaa ||2||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, only You know my objective; I stand, waiting to see the Lord's face. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗਾਲਾਇਓ ਭੂਛ ਪਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੇ ਕੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa gaalaaio bhoochh par vel na johe ka(n)t too ||
lines.translation: What should I say to you, you fool? Don't look at the vines of others - be a true husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਦੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak phulaa sa(n)dee vaaR khiRiaa habh sa(n)saar jiu ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the entire world is blooming, like a garden of flowers. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sughaR sujaan saroop too sabh mahi varata(n)taa ||
lines.translation: You are Wise, all-knowing and beautiful; You are pervading and permeating all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape thaakur sevako aape pooja(n)taa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Lord and Master, and the servant; You worship and adore Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: daanaa beenaa aap too aape satava(n)taa ||
lines.translation: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You Yourself are true and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jatee satee prabh niramalaa mere har bhagava(n)taa ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord, my Lord God, is celibate and True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh braham pasaar pasaario aape khela(n)taa ||
lines.translation: God spreads out the expanse of the entire universe, and He Himself plays in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਦੇਖੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu aavaa gavan rachaaio kar choj dekha(n)taa ||
lines.translation: He created this coming and going of reincarnation; creating the wondrous play, He gazes upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis baahuR garabh na paavahee jis devahi gur ma(n)taa ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Guru's Teachings, is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation, ever again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਦੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jiu aap chalaavahi tiu chalade kichh vas na ja(n)taa ||4||
lines.translation: All walk as He makes them walk; nothing is under the control of the created beings. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਰੀਏ ਕੁਰੀਏ ਵੈਦਿਆ ਤਲਿ ਗਾੜਾ ਮਹਰੇਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kureee kureee vaidiaa tal gaaRaa maharer ||
lines.translation: You are walking along the river-bank, but the land is giving way beneath you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੇ ਛਿਟੜਿ ਥੀਵਦੋ ਜਾਮਿ ਖਿਸੰਦੋ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vekhe chhitaR theevado jaam khisa(n)do per ||1||
lines.translation: Watch out! Your foot might slip, and you'll fall in and die. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਚੁ ਵੈਦਿਓ ਤੂ ਆਘੂ ਆਘੇ ਸਲਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach jaanai kach vaidio too aaghoo aaghe salave ||
lines.translation: You believe what is false and temporary to be true, and so you run on and on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਸੜੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨੈਣੂ ਬਿਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਬਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਜੁੰਮਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aatasaRee ma(n)jh nainoo biaa dhal paban jiu ju(n)mio ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, like butter in the fire, it shall melt away; it shall fade away like the water-lily. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੇ ਭੋਰੇ ਰੂਹੜੇ ਸੇਵੇਦੇ ਆਲਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhore bhore roohaRe sevede aalak ||
lines.translation: O my foolish and silly soul, why are you too lazy to serve?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਦਤਿ ਪਈ ਚਿਰਾਣੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਡੂ ਆਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mudat paee chiraaneeaa phir kadoo aavai rut ||3||
lines.translation: Such a long time has passed. When will this opportunity come again? ||3||
